title: Add a string helper for trimming runs of whitespace
body:
We need a small utility that collapses internal whitespace runs in arbitrary input strings. The CLI layer should be able to call it directly without going through a build step.

Acceptance:
- one entry point, no new deps
- covered by node:test
author: alice

title: Fix arithmetic edge case for negative divisor
body: When the divisor is negative, the result should still respect the sign rules. Please verify with a small set of unit tests before closing.
author: bob

title: Document the sandbox CLI in the README
body:
Future agents need a quick way to read sample issues without hitting the GitHub API. Add a `node src/issues.js list|show <id>` entry point that reads from a local fixture file.

Out of scope: live GitHub API integration, auth, web UI.
author: carol

title: Investigate flaky behavior in CI for divide helper
body: A recent run reported an intermittent failure when divide was called with arguments close to the JS number boundary. Reproduce locally and decide whether the fix belongs in the helper or in the test harness.
author: dave

title: Archive legacy v0.1.x release notes
body: Move the v0.1.x release notes out of the main README so the workflow section stays focused. Keep them reachable from a historical link.
author: alice
